title: COMBINATION: cheap upkeep + biotic return together — additive or redundant?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Both singles converted (cons 13/18 each) via different paths (upkeep economics vs biotic nutrient return). If the mechanisms are independent, the combination should hold both bars with margin to spare; if they share one bottleneck, it reads like the better single.
preregistration.prediction: cons > 0 on at least 12/18 AND prod > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (both machine). Coexistence NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED as additive if cons = 0 on 7 or more of 18: the combination adds nothing over the singles — mechanisms redundant or interfering. No triple-stacks, no escalation; the result sends the program to mechanism analysis, not to bigger combos.
preregistration.notPredicted: Coexistence rates (descriptive against excretion's 10/18 baseline), capture shares, B/D distributions.
confoundsControlled: Same 18-seed panel, horizon, engine as both singles; the ONLY differences vs viability-061 are basal 0.25 -> 0.1 AND +excretionRate:0.06 (the two promoted singles, combined)
Read against both single-arm archives to separate additive from redundant
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
producers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
